messages.decision.inspection.prediction_failed: {n, plural, one {# subject is} other {# subjects are}} held because the prediction failed: {subjects, list}.
messages.decision.inspection.prediction_abstained: {n, plural, one {# subject is} other {# subjects are}} held because the predictor abstained: {subjects, list}.
messages.decision.eligibility.outcome: {eligible, number} of {total, number} {total, plural, one {subject} other {subjects}} may be scored under the task’s evidence policy.
messages.decision.eligibility.next: {held, plural, =0 {All subjects may be scored; eligibility checks structure only and does not establish that the evidence is true.} other {Subjects that may not be scored are inspected ordinarily; fix the evidence named above and request a new decision to score them.}}
messages.decision.ranking.outcome: {eligible, number} of {total, number} {total, plural, one {subject was} other {subjects were}} scored; {held, plural, =0 {none is held for ordinary inspection} one {# is held for ordinary inspection and listed first} other {# are held for ordinary inspection and listed first}}.
messages.decision.ranking.next: Priority orders inspection only; no score, threshold or position permits excluding a subject.
messages.interaction.asserted_reason: {by} asserted the reason code {code}{detail, select, source {, naming the source {source}} digest {, with free-form detail retained only as a digest} other {}}; Shoal records this but does not verify it.
messages.router.proposal.action: Proposed, not run: the router proposes {target}, with {slots, list}. Nothing has been executed, enqueued or decided{approval, select, yes {, and the action would still require approval} other {}}.
messages.router.proposal.decision: Proposed, not run: the router proposes {target}, with {slots, list}. Nothing has been executed, enqueued or decided; the decision’s own predictor decides over its own evidence, never over the text.
messages.router.proposal.lookup: Proposed, not run: the router proposes {target}, with {slots, list}. Nothing has been executed, enqueued or decided; the template is answered over the graph, never from the text.
messages.router.next.action: To act on it, a caller would request the action through dispatch, where {approval, select, yes {admission and approval still apply} other {admission still applies}}.
messages.router.next.decision: To answer it, a caller would request the decision from its registered task, which computes it from its own evidence.
messages.router.next.lookup: To answer it, a caller would run the lookup template over the graph as it is now.
messages.router.next.abstain: Nothing will run from this abstention; rephrase the request, or name a registered target and its subjects.
messages.router.abstain.empty_text: The router abstained because the text has no words. Nothing was proposed or run.
messages.router.abstain.text_out_of_bounds: The router abstained because the text is longer than it reads. Nothing was proposed or run.
messages.router.abstain.no_target: The router abstained because the text matched no target the caller can use. Nothing was proposed or run.
messages.router.abstain.ambiguous_target: The router abstained because the text matched more than one target, and it does not choose between them. Nothing was proposed or run.
messages.router.abstain.ambiguous_executor: The router abstained because more than one agent offers the action it matched, and it does not choose between them. Nothing was proposed or run.
messages.router.abstain.ambiguous_mention: The router abstained on {target} because a name in the text could mean more than one thing for {missing, list}; it does not guess. Nothing was proposed or run.
messages.router.abstain.missing_slot: The router abstained on {target} because the text does not name {missing, list}. Nothing was proposed or run.
messages.router.abstain.slot_mismatch: The router abstained on {target} because what the text names does not fit {missing, list}. Nothing was proposed or run.
messages.router.abstain.invalid_input: The router abstained on {target} because the filled input does not match the target’s input schema. Nothing was proposed or run.
